title: Fast food chains and their country of origin

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { VALUES ?class { wd:Q18509232 wd:Q18534542 } ?item wdt:P31 ?class ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . FILTER(?sitelinks > 8) } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 300 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?n = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

country.match: Match each fast food chain to its country.
country.odd: Three of these chains are based in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: McDonald's
rows.hook: is topped by golden arches and sells the Big Mac and Happy Meals around the world

rows.label: KFC
rows.description: American fast food restaurant chain specializing in fried chicken
rows.hook: serves fried poultry from a secret blend of eleven herbs and spices, founded by a white-suited colonel

rows.label: Burger King
rows.description: global chain of hamburger fast food restaurants headquartered in Florida, United States
rows.hook: grills its flagship Whopper and has a crowned mascot with a creepy plastic face

rows.label: Chick-fil-A
rows.hook: is closed on Sundays and known for its fried sandwich, waffle fries and "my pleasure" service

rows.label: Tim Hortons
rows.hook: is a beloved national coffee and doughnut stop, famous for its Timbits and double-double order

rows.label: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers
rows.hook: specializes in breaded tenders served with a signature dipping sauce and toast

rows.label: Taco Bell
rows.hook: sells crunchy shells, Chalupas and the Crunchwrap Supreme, with a slogan about running for the border

rows.label: In-N-Out Burger
rows.description: American chain of fast food restaurants
rows.hook: is a California favorite with a short menu and a "secret menu" ordering Animal Style

rows.label: Chipotle Mexican Grill
rows.description: American fast casual Mexican restaurant chain
rows.hook: rolls big burritos and bowls assembled assembly-line style in front of you

rows.label: Wendy's
rows.description: American international fast food chain restaurant
rows.hook: is known for square patties, a red-haired pigtailed girl mascot and the Frosty dessert

rows.label: Jollibee
rows.description: Filipino multinational chain of fast food restaurants
rows.hook: is a bee-mascot chain famous for Chickenjoy fried poultry and sweet spaghetti

rows.label: Dunkin'
rows.description: American global donut company and coffeehouse
rows.hook: runs on coffee and ring-shaped fried pastries, with the slogan "America runs on" it

rows.label: Subway
rows.hook: builds made-to-order footlong sandwiches and is one of the most widespread chains on Earth

rows.label: A&W Restaurants
rows.hook: is famous for its frosty mugs of root beer and a third-pound rival to the Quarter Pounder

rows.label: Nando's
rows.description: international casual dining restaurant chain originating in South Africa
rows.hook: is known for flame-grilled peri-peri sauce on its chicken, spicy enough to have a devoted following

rows.label: Popeyes
rows.description: American multinational chain of fried chicken fast food restaurants
rows.hook: is a Louisiana-style fried chicken chain known for spicy pieces and biscuits

rows.label: Domino's Pizza
rows.hook: built its reputation on delivery within thirty minutes or less

rows.label: Dairy Queen
rows.description: American multinational fast food chain from Illinois
rows.hook: is known for its soft-serve Blizzard treat that is served upside down

rows.label: Five Guys
rows.description: burger and fries chain, based in the United States
rows.hook: serves fresh-cut fries in paper bags with free peanuts, and stacks its patties two at a time

rows.label: Panda Express
rows.description: American chain serving fast-food Chinese cuisine
rows.hook: is famous for its Orange Chicken, served with fried rice or chow mein

rows.label: Little Caesars
rows.description: American multinational pizza chain based in Detroit
rows.hook: is known for cheap takeaway pies sold with the slogan "Hot-N-Ready"

rows.label: Krispy Kreme
rows.description: American global doughnut company and coffeehouse chain
rows.hook: lights up a red neon sign when its hot glazed original rings are fresh off the line

rows.label: Steak 'n Shake
rows.hook: is a diner-style chain famous for thin, crispy-edged burgers and hand-dipped ice-cream drinks

rows.label: White Castle
rows.hook: is the oldest hamburger chain, known for tiny square sliders sold by the sack

rows.label: Jack in the Box
rows.hook: has a clown-headed spokesman who blew up the restaurant in ads and sells tacos and curly fries

rows.label: Papa John's
rows.hook: is known for its garlic dipping sauce and a slogan about better ingredients

rows.label: Arby's
rows.hook: is known for roast beef sandwiches and a slogan about having the meats, with a cowboy-hat logo

rows.label: Wingstop
rows.hook: is a wing joint known for lemon pepper and a wide range of flavors of bone-in and boneless wings

rows.label: Whataburger
rows.hook: is a Texas favorite with orange-and-white striped A-frame restaurants and a huge cult following

rows.label: Long John Silver's
rows.hook: is known for battered fish and hushpuppies at seafood counters
